text: To Ephesus: the one who walks among the lampstands speaks.
He knows their hard work and their rejection of evil and false apostles.
They have endured patiently for his name.
Yet they have lost their first love.
They must remember, repent, and return, or lose their lampstand.
They do hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, as he does.
Whoever listens and conquers will eat from the tree of life.
To Smyrna: the first and last, who died and lived, speaks.
He knows their affliction and poverty, though they are rich, and the slander against them.
They should not fear coming prison and ten days of trial; faithfulness brings a crown of life.
The one who listens and conquers will not be hurt by the second death.
To Pergamum: the one with the sharp sword speaks.
They live where Satan's throne is, yet held fast even when Antipas was killed.
But some there follow Balaam's teaching about idol food and immorality.
Some also follow the Nicolaitans.
They must repent or he will fight them with his mouth's sword.
The conqueror receives hidden manna and a white stone with a new name.
To Thyatira: the Son of God with fiery eyes speaks.
He knows their love, faith, service and growing works.
But they tolerate a woman called Jezebel who teaches his servants to compromise.
He has given her time to repent, but she refuses.
He will bring suffering on her and her followers.
He searches hearts and will repay each by their deeds.
To the faithful rest he adds no further burden.
Only hold on until he comes.
To the conqueror who keeps his works, he gives authority over nations.
This authority is like a rod of iron, as he himself received.
He will also give the morning star.
Whoever has ears should hear what the Spirit says.
